title: Customer Meeting Notes — Thomas Weber
body:
MEETING NOTES

Date: 15 May 2025
Attendees: Thomas Weber (Customer), Herr Müller (Agent)
Location: Berlin Office

SUMMARY
-------
Mr. Weber came in for a face-to-face consultation regarding health insurance options. Key points discussed:

1. Mr. Weber is particularly concerned about coverage for back problems and physiotherapy. He mentioned he has been seeing a specialist and wants better coverage than what public insurance provides.

2. He expressed a strong preference for phone communication over email, stating that he finds written communication tedious and prefers to talk things through directly.

3. He mentioned his son Lukas (age 12, living with him 50% of the time) should be included in the family coverage.

4. Lifestyle: Mr. Weber is active — cycles regularly (commutes by bike) and does photography on weekends. He seems health-conscious despite the back issues.

5. He asked about investment-linked products for retirement. As a freelance accountant, he is aware of the need for private retirement provision.

6. He mentioned considering a career change — possibly joining an established firm for more stability.

ACTION ITEMS
------------
- Send comparison of private health insurance plans (by end of week)
- Include information about Riester-Rente and Rürup-Rente options
- Follow up by PHONE (customer preference)

Notes by: Agent Müller
